tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Start API
tasks.command: $apiConnections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5023 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($apiConnections) { $apiConnections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; $envFile = '.env.local'; Get-Content $envFile | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^(.*?)=(.*)$') { $name = $matches[1].Trim(); $value = $matches[2].Trim('\"'); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') } }; dotnet run --project 'EsmatPlastic.API/EsmatPlastic.API.csproj' -p:BaseOutputPath=bin\VSCodeTask\

tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Start Desktop
tasks.command: $desktopProcesses = Get-Process -Name 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($desktopProcesses) { $desktopProcesses | Stop-Process -Force }; dotnet run --project 'EsmatPlastic.Desktop/EsmatPlastic.Desktop.csproj'

tasks.label: EsmatPlastic: Start Mobile Android
tasks.command: $project = 'EsmatPlastic.Mobile/EsmatPlastic.Mobile.csproj'; dotnet build $project -f net9.0-android; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $adb = 'C:\Users\Dell\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $adb)) { throw 'Android adb.exe was not found.' }; $onlineDevice = & $adb devices | Select-String '\s+device$' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $onlineDevice) { throw 'No online Android device or emulator is connected.' }; $serial = $onlineDevice.Line.Split()[0]; $apk = Get-ChildItem 'EsmatPlastic.Mobile/bin/Debug/net9.0-android' -Filter 'com.esmatplastic.mobile-Signed.apk' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $apk) { throw 'Signed Android APK was not found.' }; & $adb -s $serial install -r $apk.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $adb -s $serial shell monkey -p com.esmatplastic.mobile -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1; exit $LASTEXITCODE
